kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center renew-app-instance-group --product-type CloudApp --promotion-id 174400090000 --auto-pay false --period 1 --period-unit Week --app-instance-group-id aig-9ciijz60n4xsv0000 --renew-mode example-string --renew-amount 1 --renew-nodes example-string --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewAppInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The promotion ID. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428503.html operation
parameters.name: promotion_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The numeric part of the resource purchase duration. This parameter is used together with `PeriodUnit` to represent the complete purchase duration
parameters.help_zh: 资源购买时长的数量部分，与`PeriodUnit`一起表示完整的购买时长
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit part of the resource purchase duration. This parameter is used together with `Period` to represent the complete purchase duration. Valid combinations of `Period` and `PeriodUnit`:

- 1 Week
- 1 Month
- 2 Month
- 3 Month
- 6 Month
- 1 Year
- 2 Year
- 3 Year

> This parameter is case-sensitive. For example, `Week` is valid, but `week` is invalid. If the request parameters do not match the valid combinations listed above, such as `2 Week`, the call to this operation succeeds, but an error occurs during the order placement phase
parameters.help_zh:
资源购买时长的单位部分，与`Period`一起表示完整的购买时长。可使用的`Period`与`PeriodUnit`的搭配如下：

- 1 Week（1周）
- 1 Month（1个月）
- 2 Month（2个月）
- 3 Month（3个月）
- 6 Month（6个月）
- 1 Year（1年）
- 2 Year（2年）
- 3 Year（3年）

> 该参数区分大小写。例如，`Week`是有效的，`week`是无效的。另外，如果请求参数不符合上述搭配，例如`2 Week`，虽然调用本接口会成功，但最终在下单阶段会出错
